description: This grouped bar chart illustrates two distinct metrics, "Accuracy (%)" and "Token Count," evaluated across four different methods. The horizontal axis categorizes the data into two main visual groupings corresponding to these metrics, though it lacks a specific overarching axis label. The chart utilizes dual vertical value axes: the left y-axis represents "Accuracy (%)" on a linear scale ranging from 70 to 100 with tick intervals of 5, while the right y-axis represents "Token Count" on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 800 with tick intervals of 100. A legend at the bottom identifies the four methods, which are represented by colored bars with thin black outlines: CoT (reddish-brown), CoD (brown), CCoT (grayish-blue), and CoUT (green). In the left grouping for Accuracy, the exact values are annotated above each bar, showing CoT as the highest at 91.19, followed by CCoT at 88.50, CoUT at 88.40, and CoD as the lowest at 80.89. In the right grouping for Token Count, the bars are visually sorted in descending order, with exact values annotated as follows: CoT is the tallest at 676.85, followed by CoD at 534.24, CCoT at 445.91, and CoUT is the shortest at 354.46. All bars are visually emphasized by the exact numerical annotations placed directly above them, and faint horizontal grid lines extend across the dark gray background corresponding to the left y-axis intervals.
